title: Fake police - family member in an accident

events.speaker: scammer
events.text: Main Inspector Kumar bol raha hoon, Local Police Desk (SIMULATION). Aapka beta accident mein pakda gaya hai aur custody mein hai.

tactics.evidence_span: Aapka beta accident mein pakda gaya hai aur custody

events.summary: कुछ खतरे के संकेत हैं। अभी कोई जानकारी या पैसे न दें।

events.text: Koi likhit notice bhejiye na, main padh ke samajh lungi. Kahan bhejenge?

events.speaker: scammer
events.text: FIR FIR-66120 darj ho gayi hai. Badge number SIM-66120. Case badh sakta hai.

events.summary: This looks like a scam. Do not pay, do not share codes, hang up.
what_to_do: Hang up. Police, CBI, ED and courts do not arrest people over video calls.
Do not send money, share OTP/PIN, or install any app.
If money was already sent, call 1930 immediately.
Report at cybercrime.gov.in.
Tell a family member now.

अगर पैसे भेज दिए हैं तो तुरंत 1930 पर कॉल करें।
cybercrime.gov.in पर शिकायत दर्ज करें।
अभी परिवार के किसी सदस्य को बताएं।
